reviews.text:
Excellent treatment from the doctors and reception staff; it's comforting to have this place to help us.

They guided us with patience, and since my pet started treatment, we've seen her improve.

Words can't express our gratitude for their empathy. These diagnoses are never what we want, but having people like this makes the burden much lighter. Special thanks to Dr. Monse, Dr. Cecy, and the reception staff.

It's difficult to express in a few words all the gratitude we feel for the care our Magguie received during her radiotherapy.

From our first contact with them in León, we received incredibly warm attention from Dulce and Marlene at reception. In a moment filled with worry and uncertainty, they guided us with great clarity and empathy. There are some words I still remember: "Believe me, everything is going to be alright." It may seem like a simple phrase, but when you're going through something like this with such a beloved member of your family, hearing it truly brings a little light and hope.

From the initial assessment appointment, we felt we were in good hands. They thoroughly explained the treatment, its benefits, the possible complications, and each step we would follow, but in a simple, honest, and easy-to-understand way. And from that first day, their affection for Magguie was evident; she even received two cookies. ❤️

Throughout the entire treatment, we could see that they are not only excellent professionals, but also people with tremendous human qualities. Our doctor, Pricila, has been incredibly attentive and continues to follow up with Magguie even weeks after she finished her treatment.

There were small details that meant so much to us. Knowing that even during the anesthesia for her radiation sessions, they covered her, wrapped her up, and cared for her with such tenderness, almost as if she were one of their own dogs, gave us a peace of mind that's hard to explain.

We also want to thank Mr. Jorge, always so kind and friendly, who made our stay and the waiting times so much more pleasant.

Today, after this process has ended and Magguie has had such a positive response, we feel that no review is truly enough to thank them for everything they did for her and for us.

When you arrive at a place like this, you carry fear, doubts, and a great deal of hope placed in those who will be caring for someone you love. We found knowledge and professionalism, but we also found empathy, patience, affection, and a profoundly human touch.

Thank you for taking care of our Magguie with so much love. We will always remember what you did for her. ❤️🐾

I am endlessly grateful to the entire COV team.
Thank you to the medical team and the reception staff; they always make us feel welcome and show that they love my little one very much ❤️

I took my dog ​​to this cancer clinic during a very difficult time, expecting to feel supported and well cared for. Unfortunately, my experience with the administrative staff was terrible. The "administrator" was rude to me, and while I was at reception, I noticed her and the other receptionists talking amongst themselves and looking at me, which made me feel uncomfortable and judged.

When you arrive with a sick pet and all the worries that entails, the least you expect is respect, discretion, and kind treatment. Here, I found NONE of that. I hope they improve their customer service, because human interaction is just as important as the doctor in a place like this.
The doctors' care is excellent; my pet has shown positive progress! The facilities and overall service are very good. I highly recommend the clinic (10/10).
All the staff were very friendly and professional. Highly recommended.

I'm delighted with the service at this place; it's clear they love our furry friends. The patience and care of absolutely all the staff gives us peace of mind knowing our pets are in good hands, from the moment we walk in until we leave.

Many thanks to all the staff; the reception team was incredibly kind and attentive.
The veterinarians answered all our questions. The diagnosis will obviously never be exactly what we'd hoped for since they recommended these specialists, but we're reassured knowing they're the experts and are doing everything they can to help us and our pets.

The doctor's care is excellent, but what many people say about the reception staff is correct. I don't know if they're not getting the details or what's going on. They don't respond to messages (unless it's to make an appointment).

Experiences with cancer are incredibly difficult for our dogs and our families. However, we have an exceptionally professional, well-prepared, and compassionate team to support us through these processes!

Thank you to the entire COV team, and especially to Dr. Priscila, for your kindness and for allowing us to share more years with our four-legged companions!
I love going to the doctor's office; the treatment is always friendly, the doctors are very helpful, and everyone is very attentive.

We scheduled an appointment over a week ago, and when we arrived, they had made a mistake with the date. They refused to see us, even though it was their error, and to make matters worse, they were rude and arrogant.
We traveled from far away because our dog has cancer and we urgently needed the appointment. We scheduled it well in advance and even had a screenshot confirming our appointment. How could they tell us this?!
A terrible experience and terrible service.

Terrible service. They didn't honor the scheduled appointment, hung up the phone, and refused to take responsibility for their mistakes. We traveled far away, and just because they wrote down the wrong date, we lost time and money. Our pets felt terrible! On top of that, they had a rude and arrogant attitude, simply hanging up on us.

Dr. Montserrat provided excellent care. She explained the treatment in incredible detail and was extremely professional.

She has been following up with my kitten even weeks after the treatment, asking how he is doing. I am so grateful for her compassionate care of my kitten. She is an excellent doctor, and the cancer center is very good.

In my experience, the care my pet received was very poor. They didn't respect appointment times or the length of the appointments, since I had to go during my work hours. When I took him for the electrocardiogram and blood test, they mistakenly didn't do the blood test. I was very upset because one trip meant having to rearrange my work schedule, ask for time off, and pay for Uber Pet. And when I requested a refund, it took them almost a month to process it.
The consultation was also very poor. During the weeks I was taking him there, my pet's skin problem worsened. I asked the vet, and she only told me it was a hormonal problem related to the tumors, and that he wouldn't improve until those were resolved. I asked for recommendations, and she only confirmed what I had already researched online: oatmeal baths, coconut oil, and omega supplements. I had to go to another veterinarian. I went to one who gave me comprehensive and much better advice. The person who treated my pet's skin problem gave me recommendations and a better prognosis for their condition. They emphasized the risks of the procedure they wanted to perform on my pet, risks that were never mentioned to me at COV.

In addition to all this, their prices are exorbitant. 900 for a consultation that didn't help me. And regarding the reimbursement for the tests, I got them done elsewhere and saved 750. Therefore, I recommend looking for other places and not relying on just one opinion.

Excellent experience with the entire team. We arrived in Guadalajara with Pancho at a very difficult time, and from day one they made us feel we were in the best hands. Besides their professionalism and expertise, I would especially highlight their human touch, the affection with which they treat Pancho, and their patience in explaining and supporting me throughout his treatment. It's genuinely clear that they care about each patient. I couldn't be more grateful to the whole team for taking such good care of my little guy. ❤️🐾
Excellent service
An excellent clinic, excellent people, from the secretaries to the doctors, they do a tremendous job, may God continue to bless them.

For those who visit this clinic, please be very careful with the diagnosis. I understand it's an oncology clinic, but their diagnosis always includes the possibility of cancer, even for routine checkups.

They tell you that you have to run tests even when the dog appears healthy. These tests can cost up to 20,000 pesos, and they even offer a payment plan.

The service was decent, and they surely have trained staff when needed, but in our case, that wasn't the case, and that's why I can't give it more than one star due to the negligence in the diagnosis.
Excellent place, everyone is very dedicated to their work and their patients, they do everything possible to make sure our pets are well. I highly recommend it.
Excellent service! And cutting-edge technology

My 14-year-old dog had surgery, and I was super nervous because of his age and because they were going to perform spleen surgery and remove two other masses he had outside his skin. Everything went perfectly, and I loved the care they provide and how much they care for the pets even after the surgery. I work from home, and they even let me work there while he was having his operation. I'm so grateful for the customer service and the doctors. I highly recommend them, and you can tell they really love their pets. I still take my fur baby there. Thank you so much for everything! 🤎✨

The staff is incredibly friendly, from the security personnel and administrative staff to the veterinarians.
The place is very clean, and you can see the love and care they give the dogs. The wall of photos of the pups after their treatments is really cool.

We brought Frida from Mexico City for radiation therapy. From the beginning, they provided excellent follow-up, explaining the process to us. I appreciated the communication between our veterinary oncologist in Mexico City and the clinic in Guadalajara; it felt like they already knew Frida from her first session. Even though there were only two sessions, they gave Frida a wonderful graduation gift at the end.

It's clear the entire team there loves animals because they treat the dogs with so much respect and affection. Team COV, we thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making this difficult experience so manageable.
Excellent service, I highly recommend it.

Excellent service. Great empathy from all the staff.

The doctors were incredibly capable, kind, and attentive.
The hospital was superbly equipped, clean, and reliable. Thank you so much for everything.
Everything was great. I would like longer hours. But everything was excellent.

Like many others here, I believe there's a need to improve the reception staff's service, as well as the communication and follow-up from the veterinarians.

In my case, I went there seeking guidance on my cat's care. During the initial consultation, the veterinarian told me she would consult with the surgeon about my cat's treatment and that if I wanted or needed more details directly from him, then it would be necessary to schedule an appointment.

After the consultation, I followed up several times and received no response; even my messages went unanswered. Finally, follow-up resumed only after a medical representative from the clinic came to my workplace and directly asked the staff to follow up on my cat's case. Later, I was told that the lack of response was due to them being at a conference and having a full schedule.

From then on, there was also confusion regarding the appointment with the surgeon. First, I was told that I hadn't requested an appointment with him, and then, unexpectedly, I received a link to schedule said appointment, which I hadn't requested.

I believe this should have been clearly communicated from the beginning. If it had been explained to me during the initial consultation that an additional consultation was required to obtain the surgeon's opinion on the treatment, I would have understood. The problem was that I was initially told the doctor would consult with him about the case and that the additional consultation would only be necessary if I subsequently needed a more detailed evaluation or explanation directly from the surgeon.

The prices seemed high to me, although I understand that it is a specialized clinic and that this may be reflected in its costs. However, when dealing with prices at this level, I would also expect commensurate attention, communication, and follow-up.

This experience caused me to lose confidence in the clinic, and I decided to continue my patient's case elsewhere. I hope you can take these comments into account and improve these aspects so that other clients can have a better experience.

We went without an appointment because we weren't aware we needed to schedule one beforehand, but they treated us very well. From the moment we arrived, they greeted us warmly. All the staff, from doctors to non-doctors, were incredibly patient and explained the procedures to us no matter how many times we asked. When you go to these places desperate, you're not thinking straight, and they were so patient and empathetic from the beginning to the end of our visit. We'll be visiting them regularly, not for the reasons we'd like, but it's still such a relief to have such wonderful people there for my little one.

Excellent service. They turned my doubts into peace.

100% recommended. I came from Mexico City. They advised and supported me every step of the way. Thank you so much to the whole team for everything.
I just want to thank everyone for their great work. They transformed those feelings of anguish into certainty and peace.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at the COV Veterinary Oncology Clinic in Guadalajara.

From the first day my furry friend was diagnosed with cancer, they welcomed us with incredible empathy, professionalism, and warmth. They not only treated my pet with the best medicine and cutting-edge treatments, explaining everything to us with great patience, but they also supported us as a family during a very difficult time.

Thank you for your excellent care, your honesty, the love you show each and every pet, and for never giving up. It's clear you love what you do. My dog ​​was in the best hands.

I highly recommend COV to anyone going through this situation. They are the best.
Thank you so much!

Delighted with the excellent service. The doctors explained everything in detail; it's a highly specialized service, and I'm so grateful that Cov exists. My family is eternally grateful; blessings to the team.

I swore they had better service. I think it's the only clinic
with radiotherapy. However, I recommend you go to Valles; that's a proper hospital, and obviously they don't rush you out after surgery. They keep you under observation the first night and offer chemotherapy. If your pet needs something else that they don't offer there, well, too bad, go to COV. The service is horrible; they're only interested in money. I could upload a conversation where they operated on my dog, and as soon as he came out of surgery, they wanted me to come pick him up because they wanted the space and because of work, hahaha, they're a joke. They don't care about your pet's well-being, only money, and besides, they stop providing service at 5 pm. Any emergency, you're on your own. That's not possible in a place that performs surgeries, don't you think? Personally, it's no good; go to the Valles clinic instead, and if your pet needs it there, you can schedule appointments. Only for radiotherapy. Besides, they never answer, they're infuriating, and the receptionists are very rude.

It's a well-equipped oncology clinic with good veterinary oncologists.

The service is very slow, and the receptionists are incredibly rude.

For an oncology clinic where major surgeries are obviously performed, it's unbelievable that they close at 6 pm and then kick our furry friends out immediately after removing the malignant tumors without even a one-day hospital stay. At the very least, I think there should be 24-hour emergency assistance, at least by phone.

This place is very special. I love the attention they give us.
The whole team.

Thank you, Montse ✌🏽
Excellent service.
Excellent service from everyone, many thanks especially to Dr. Priscila for her care and for keeping an eye on her recovery; everyone was always very loving with my dog.

Excellent hospital.
We thank all the staff for helping my Buster.
Absolutely everything was excellent.

Incredible place! We are so grateful for their professionalism and excellent service. Dr. Monse is amazing, as are Dr. Ceci, Dr. Sofi, and Andrea. The reception team, Marlen and Dulce, are also incredibly attentive, from reception and administration to security. They are all true professionals.

Congratulations! You saved my Balo from tumors. We recommend you 200%.

Thank you so much!

We had to say goodbye to my dog ​​on Saturday, August 1st, and to this day her oncologist hasn't contacted us to ask how she's doing, or if she was even interested in supporting us through this situation. She kept saying that the important thing about this place and their professions as veterinary oncologists was "supporting us through the process."

I'm left with a bad taste in my mouth after seeing this place, not so much because of the high prices, since I did everything I could to cover my pet's expenses, and money was the last thing on my mind. I just wanted her to recover, and I had faith that this place was very good. And I have no doubt that their treatments are good, since I've seen so many testimonials from other pets who have recovered there, and that's why I had faith that mine would be the next to achieve that. Unfortunately, the cancer progressed too quickly, and I'm left with a broken heart.

What I'm trying to say is that at the beginning, I received incredible, warm, and passionate care from Dr. Lily. But then things changed because she had to leave, and that's when things got worse. They ignored me when I told them I was seeing inflammation again in specific parts of her body, and all they kept saying was that "it's normal." It wasn't until the inflammation became very noticeable that they finally did something (and there wasn't much improvement). Then I realized I was right, and perhaps this could have been avoided, and her life could have been extended a little longer with those "small details" I noticed.

I could go on and on, but the way they ignored me from that moment on made me know that everything had changed drastically for the worse. Nothing could guarantee it, though, but the first time she deteriorated and I wasn't getting a response from her doctor because it was Sunday, I had to contact Lily again. She answered me within minutes without any problem and helped me resolve the issue, and I'm very grateful for that. I went to the Dactary hospital they're affiliated with, and it wasn't until then that I found out about that association. The doctor on duty at that hospital told me that COV had already mentioned it and notified them—specifically, he mentioned Dr. Monse, with whom I hadn't had much contact, and when I did, she almost gave my pet the wrong chemotherapy the only time she treated her (be careful with her records)—that I would probably take my pet there in the following days without knowing about the existence of that place. How is that possible? I know that COV isn't a 24-hour hospital and that we all have the right to fair working hours and to only be able to attend to pending matters within the established schedule, but we're talking about a MEDICAL PROFESSION dealing with ONCOLOGY patients, whether human or animal. It's not just any old thing. It would be good if they improved their logistics and at least made the phone available most of the day so they could guide us. They're not obligated to come to our homes to examine our pets or open their clinic outside of regular hours to see them. Just providing guidance and offering "support" outside the office without prior appointment would be good and would make us, the pet owners, truly feel supported. I don't expect an apology or a response to this comment; if it can help and they actually take it into account, that would be perfect. Because I've already been reading some comments here and I wouldn't be the first to complain about Dr. Priscila Villareal, since I agree with everything that was mentioned but I kept it to myself here, I hope this is the last related one and that she takes it as something constructive to improve instead of attacking and hostile.

The doctors and receptionists provided terrible service; it felt like you were BEGGING them for attention. They deleted meaningless messages, sent incorrect information, etc. This is UNACCEPTABLE when dealing with ONCOLOGY patients. The time of people and beings with these illnesses should not be trifled with like this clinic does. It's deplorable. I have family members who have spent over $120,000 MXN on their dogs only for them to die within five days. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic.

I'm left with a very bitter taste in my mouth after Dr. Lily left. She was the one who treated our dog from the beginning of her chemotherapy treatment, and the service changed drastically after she left. Dr. Priscila didn't provide the emergency care we needed. She didn't give us any tools or suggestions for when they were off duty, as she wouldn't answer after 5 pm or on weekends. It's not like cancer patients disappear on weekends. They lack empathy for patients and their families, as it's not easy to go through these situations. They should consider providing more training for their doctors. Our dog is no longer with us, and we no longer have that support or guidance. Terrible.
Everyone was super nice, the service was excellent, and the doctors had a great attitude.

We arrived at the clinic after searching online for a reliable option, having received three different diagnoses from three different veterinarians. Since we didn't know anyone who could give us direct recommendations, we went to one of our local veterinarians. Although he wasn't familiar with the clinic either, he researched its Instagram profile and told us that leading veterinary researchers and prominent speakers followed it. That reassured us that it was the right place.

We traveled from another city without an appointment. We arrived early on a Monday; the receptionists gave us a warm welcome, understood the specifics of our case, and explained that we would have to wait. After a couple of hours, Dr. Monse saw us.

The consultation lasted approximately an hour and a half. Dr. Monse and her team examined our Isabella from head to toe, created her medical record, and listened attentively to everything we had to say. They reviewed the images and prescriptions we had received from other veterinarians, and finally, the doctor was very clear and concise: she explained the basis of the previous diagnoses but clarified that to be absolutely certain, they needed samples, a CT scan, and other tests. Only then would we obtain a definitive result to develop a treatment plan. Knowing that we were in the city solely for Isabella, the doctor made time to perform the necessary tests on Tuesday and tried to get a preliminary result before our return home on Friday.

As a father who wants the best for his family, the Veterinary Oncology Clinic was exactly what I needed. They gave me the reassurance that they knew what they were doing and that they would give my baby the necessary care. Is it expensive? Yes, compared to a regular clinic, but if you are looking for a specialized center with an excellent medical and technical team, this is the right place.

We are currently waiting for the treatment plan. Isabella already has a clear diagnosis and we are fully confident that, under the guidance of Dr. Monse and her team, Chabelita will have the best quality of life and the best possible treatment.
Excellent service, and the doctor was incredibly kind and empathetic with our children and with us as well. Her assistants were also incredibly kind and lovely. 100% recommended!
Excellent service, highly trained staff, and a very clean clinic with all the necessary precautions.
It is a great blessing to have a service nearby that supports us and offers solutions in situations as difficult as cancer in a member of your family.
Excellent service, the medical team is highly trained and has everything necessary to treat cancer in our pets.

I want to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received at the reception area of ​​the Veterinary Oncology Center (COV).

When I requested the follow-up appointment, I specifically asked for Dr. Montse, as she has been handling my pet's case from the beginning. I even called and sent a WhatsApp message to confirm that she would be the one seeing us before traveling to Guadalajara specifically for that appointment.

Upon arriving, before my appointment time, the receptionists simply whispered among themselves while I waited standing, without offering any explanation. After a while, they only told me that I would be seen shortly. To my surprise, the doctor who received us was not Dr. Montse, but another doctor, and it was only then that I learned that Dr. Montse was at a conference.

I completely understand that veterinarians attend conferences to stay up-to-date, and I believe that this benefits their patients. My frustration isn't with her absence, but with the lack of communication and consideration shown to those of us who trusted her care. The correct course of action would have been to check the doctor's schedule and contact the owners of the patients scheduled for those days in advance to inform them of the situation and allow them to decide whether they preferred to reschedule the appointment or be seen by another specialist.

In my case, I would undoubtedly have chosen to reschedule the appointment and postpone my trip to wait for Dr. Montse's return. She knows my furry friend's medical history and has been managing her treatment from the beginning.

After the appointment, I spoke with the administrator to personally express my dissatisfaction. I want to clarify that the doctor who saw us was kind and professional; my dissatisfaction isn't with her, but with how the situation was handled from reception and the lack of prior information.

The results of this consultation were not encouraging, so I am still waiting to hear the opinion of Dr. Montse, who has been involved in the case from the beginning and whose judgment I trust. I also hope that this feedback will be taken into account to improve communication with pet owners, since a timely call or message would have prevented an unnecessary trip, additional expenses, and great disappointment at a time that is already very difficult for those of us dealing with cancer in our pets.

The doctors were wonderful and very empathetic with our furry friends.
We understand that the prices might be a bit high, but we're talking about ONCOLOGY; it's not just any illness, and the staff here are clearly very well-trained in this area.
From the moment we called to schedule the appointment, the service has been excellent.
We had some questions about a surgery, and we were able to speak directly with the surgeon, who answered all our questions ❤️

The doctors were very attentive. However, the wait times are very long. They give you an appointment date, and when you ask, they say it will be the following week, to get results, schedule appointments, etc.
The offices are dirty and shared. And it's very expensive for what they offer.

My dog's initial care was here. The doctors who treated us were very kind and professional. Their tests and diagnosis were accurate. Overall, everything is top-notch.
I couldn't continue there because of the distance (it was too far away), but if you need oncologists and it's nearby, don't hesitate to go to them.

Honestly, it's such a relief to have a veterinary clinic in the city. They treat pets incredibly well, they know a great deal about oncology, and the entire system, from arrival to treatment, is world-class. I'm grateful they also took care of my pet (Caleb).

The receptionists, who also handle WhatsApp messages, are TERRIBLE. It's like you have to beg them; they don't even read the messages, replying with nonsensical things and deleting them five minutes later. If you ask them for something, they take HOURS or even DAYS to respond. We're talking about ONCOLOGY patients, and these are URGENT and sensitive matters, so they shouldn't be taking all the time they need to answer. I was at the clinic one day from morning until afternoon, and I can confirm that they are NOT so busy that they can't answer A SINGLE MESSAGE. They just spend their time eating, on their phones, criticizing, and making faces at you.

It's a shame because they have some very good doctors, and if it weren't for that, I wouldn't go back.
I am very grateful to the entire COV team. They not only cared for Valentino with great affection, but they were also very clear and punctual with the information, procedures, and treatment.
Excellent clinic and excellent treatment of our fur babies, good oncology care, highly recommended for a good diagnosis

A clinic with innovative equipment and, I have no doubt, well-trained veterinarians; however, in matters of ethics... they leave much to be desired. They order unnecessary tests and expect you to have them done there at the clinic. As soon as I started getting the tests done elsewhere (because they are extremely expensive there), the veterinary care and follow-up were nonexistent and completely lacking in empathy. If their goal is to make money from tests, then they should only offer that, but it's very sad that they are an "oncology clinic," which is a very delicate field in both dogs and humans, and they are completely unempathetic and take advantage of one's desperation and lack of knowledge. The veterinarians even try to scare people by showing extremely serious clinical cases, telling you that if you don't treat the animal quickly, that's how it will remain, so that you, frightened, will do everything there. I went to get two opinions from other veterinary oncologists, and they truly lacked ethics in that regard.

This is for your consideration regarding the Priscila Villareal veterinary clinic.
They are incredibly attentive and caring towards all their patients.

Here's my honest review of the place, which leaves me with mixed feelings.

Points for improvement:
High costs: The prices are high; each visit represents a significant expense. I'm speaking from my experience as someone with an average salary, so it's worth considering in your budget.

Poor customer service: It's nearly impossible to contact them to schedule an appointment or to get test results. You have to constantly chase them down to get a response.

The positives:
Despite the above, I continue to go because the veterinarians are highly trained professionals. They take wonderful care of our pets, are usually very punctual with appointment times, and take the time to explain everything in detail during the consultation.
Excellent service from the staff, but there is not enough parking or security.
Excellent service
They clearly know their stuff and explain things well, but we were left waiting for a quote for treatments/surgery and they never sent it. We even sent a message and they just left us on read.
They saved my dog ​​and at 15 years old he is still alive and happy

I want to express my deepest gratitude to COV and especially to Dr. Miriam Navarro for all the care, empathy, and professionalism with which they supported Peppa throughout her journey.

From the very first moment, we felt a very humane and caring approach towards her. Dr. Miriam always patiently explained everything to us, guided us every step of the way, and treated Peppa with great respect and love.

Although Peppa is no longer with us, I find peace in knowing that she was in the hands of a wonderful doctor. I am certain that she could not have received better care and support during this stage of her life.

Thank you for your dedication and for the love with which you treat each patient. We will always be deeply grateful.
Dr. Cervantes and his team are excellent.
Excellent service from reception and the doctors; all very kind and professional. Zoe sends her best wishes. Thank you for everything.

It's an excellent clinic; they have all the necessary equipment. From the beginning, the doctors were honest with their diagnoses. I wanted to thank Dr. Lily and Dr. Fabiola for treating Toby. His diagnosis wasn't the best, but they always tried to minimize Toby's pain and provided follow-up care. 🤗 Thank you; now Toby is pain-free in that area. 💗
Extremely expensive. Ridiculously priced. Studies more expensive than those for a human. Very expensive.
Excellent service, Max is always happy to visit the clinic. Thank you, Dr. Miriam.

Hi! 😊 I highly recommend COV Clinic for your pets. The staff is very attentive and the specialists are highly professional. The care is personalized, and you can tell they love what they do ❤️. I adopted my dog, Loba, who has TVT, and she's being treated there. She receives her chemotherapy treatments, and the results are amazing. The clinic is very clean and has a welcoming atmosphere. It's an excellent option for your pet's health! 🐾💕
The staff are very professional and efficient; they treated my dog ​​very well.

The entire staff at this clinic is very professional and provides excellent care for pets. They have the necessary equipment to make accurate diagnoses and recommend the treatments needed for the animals' recovery. I am very grateful to them because they have been a great help in providing a better quality of life for my dog. They go out of their way to care for him and pamper him every time I need their services.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

The treatment my dog ​​Dot and I received from all the doctors and staff at COV Guadalajara was beyond extraordinary. They are all warriors fulfilling their mission like angels on earth; each one is a truly dedicated veterinarian, committed to helping your pet with the best service, the best equipment, and the best technology available. Their treatment was generous, warm, and incredibly empathetic. There are few veterinarians like them, if not the only ones in Mexico.
Excellent service, friendly attention and very professional; Nala's treatment was top-notch.
They treated us very well and took great care of my dog; we are very grateful for the love and care they showed Miesha!

Dr. Monse seemed knowledgeable, but when I asked her questions about my dog's treatment, she seemed annoyed and responded aggressively, pressuring me to order CT scans instead of X-rays and to perform surgery as soon as possible, without really caring about giving my dog ​​other options. The doctor who performed the ultrasound on my dog ​​treated him very well and answered all my questions willingly, but I honestly don't recommend this place.
The service is truly unique; all the staff have an exceptional warmth and kindness. Only gratitude and many blessings for COV.
Terrible service
Excellent service for four-legged family members, very satisfied

Terrible service from the person who answers the phone. You ask if they can give you available dates and times for a consultation and they tell you to send them a message via WhatsApp and they never respond; you have to beg them.
It was very convenient to have an online session so I didn't have to travel to Guadalajara. Dr. Lily was always very professional and empathetic.
Excellent service, parking is sometimes difficult but the care for the dogs is excellent
Excellent service, very tactful when dealing with health issues, and inspires confidence.
Many thanks to Lupita for the incredible attention she gave us ❤️
Excellent service. The treatments are difficult for both pets and owners, and the attitude of all the staff is excellent, helpful, and above all, incredibly empathetic and patient.

Unique in all of Mexico and with excellent service. Everyone at COV has a direct pass to heaven for their important work saving our little angels 🐕‍🦺🪽 on the four-legged guard 🐾 🐾.
Thank you, COV. …
